rows.ja: ローン債権の買い手・資金の出し手
提携・決済・暗号資産
銀行・融資の取りまとめ
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 個人ローンの証券化(3.75億ドル)を、BlackRockの運用ファンド・口座のみに販売
relations.text_en: Placed a $375M personal loan securitization exclusively with funds and accounts managed by BlackRock investment advisors

source.label: SoFi の発表(2023年10月30日)
source.quote: today announced an agreement to place a $375 million personal loan securitization exclusively with funds and accounts managed by BlackRock (NYSE: BLK) investment advisors.
source.note: 2023年の単発の取引で、相手はBlackRockが運用するファンドです。
source.note_en: A one-off 2023 transaction with BlackRock-managed funds.

relations.text: Blue Owlが運用するファンドと、最大50億ドル・2年間の個人ローン事業(Loan Platform Business)契約を確定
relations.text_en: Finalized an up to $5B two-year Loan Platform Business agreement for personal loans with funds managed by Blue Owl Capital

source.label: SoFi の発表(2025年3月13日)
source.quote: SoFi Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SOFI) finalized an up to $5 billion Loan Platform Business agreement for personal loans with funds managed by Blue Owl Capital
source.note: 相手はBlue Owlが運用するファンドで、期間は2025年3月からの2年間です。
source.note_en: The counterparty is funds managed by Blue Owl; two-year term from March 2025.

relations.text: 2024年第4四半期に、5.25億ドルの個人ローン証券化をPGIM Fixed Incomeが運用するファンド・口座と実施
relations.text_en: Closed a $525M personal loan securitization in Q4 2024 with funds and accounts managed by PGIM Fixed Income

source.label: SoFi の発表(2025年1月16日)
source.quote: a $525 million personal loan securitization agreement closed in Q4 2024 with funds and accounts managed by PGIM Fixed Income
source.note: 相手はPrudential傘下のPGIM Fixed Incomeです。
source.note_en: The counterparty is PGIM Fixed Income, an asset manager within Prudential Financial.

relations.text: Mastercardと提携を強化し、SoFiのステーブルコインSoFiUSDをMastercardの世界の決済網での決済手段にできるようにする
relations.text_en: Announced an enhanced partnership with Mastercard to enable its SoFiUSD stablecoin as a settlement option across Mastercard’s global payments network

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年3月3日)
source.quote: SoFi Technologies, Inc. today announced an enhanced partnership with Mastercard to enable SoFiUSD as a settlement option across Mastercard’s global payments network.

relations.text: Mastercardは、法人向けの法定通貨・暗号資産バンキング「SoFi Big Business Banking」の最初の参加企業となる予定だ
relations.text_en: Mastercard will be an initial participant in SoFi Big Business Banking, SoFi’s fiat and crypto banking offering for enterprise partners

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年4月2日)
source.quote: Initial participants will include Cumberland, Bullish, BitGo, B2C2, Fireblocks, Wintermute, Galaxy, Jupiter, Mesh Payments, and Mastercard.
source.note: 開始時の参加企業の一覧で、参加条件の詳細は書かれていません。
source.note_en: An initial-participant list at launch; participation terms are not detailed.

relations.text: SoFi Big Business Bankingには、最初の参加企業としてBullishが加わる見込みだ
relations.text_en: Bullish will be an initial participant in SoFi Big Business Banking

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年4月2日)
source.quote: Initial participants will include Cumberland, Bullish, BitGo, B2C2, Fireblocks, Wintermute, Galaxy, Jupiter, Mesh Payments, and Mastercard.
source.note: 開始時の参加企業の一覧で、参加条件の詳細は書かれていません。
source.note_en: An initial-participant list at launch; participation terms are not detailed.

relations.text: BitGoもSoFi Big Business Bankingに最初から参加する構想だ
relations.text_en: BitGo will be an initial participant in SoFi Big Business Banking

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年4月2日)
source.quote: Initial participants will include Cumberland, Bullish, BitGo, B2C2, Fireblocks, Wintermute, Galaxy, Jupiter, Mesh Payments, and Mastercard.
source.note: 開始時の参加企業の一覧で、参加条件の詳細は書かれていません。
source.note_en: An initial-participant list at launch; participation terms are not detailed.

relations.text: GalaxyはSoFi Big Business Bankingの最初の参加企業に名を連ねる見通し
relations.text_en: Galaxy will be an initial participant in SoFi Big Business Banking

source.label: SoFi の発表(2026年4月2日)
source.quote: Initial participants will include Cumberland, Bullish, BitGo, B2C2, Fireblocks, Wintermute, Galaxy, Jupiter, Mesh Payments, and Mastercard.
source.note: 開始時の参加企業の一覧です。「Galaxy」はGalaxy Digitalと解釈しています。
source.note_en: An initial-participant list; “Galaxy” is read as Galaxy Digital.

relations.text: Templum経由で、SoFiの会員がStepStone Private Markets Fundを利用できるようにした
relations.text_en: SoFi gave members access to the StepStone Private Markets Fund through its relationship with Templum

source.label: SoFi の発表(2024年12月4日)
source.quote: announced access to three new private market funds through a relationship with Templum
source.note: 利用はTemplum(未上場)のプラットフォーム経由で、SoFiの直接の取引相手はStepStoneとは限りません。
source.note_en: Access is via the Templum (private) platform; SoFi’s direct counterparty is not necessarily StepStone.

relations.text: Goldman Sachs Bank USAが、SoFiの改定済み回転与信契約の管理代理人
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs Bank USA is administrative agent under SoFi’s amended and restated revolving credit agreement

source.label: SoFi 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the issuing banks party thereto and Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as administrative agent.
source.note: 相手は子会社のGoldman Sachs Bank USAです。
source.note_en: The counterparty is the subsidiary Goldman Sachs Bank USA.

relations.text: SoFiの6.976億ドルの個人ローン証券化で、組成代理人・共同主幹事を務めた
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs was structuring agent and joint lead bookrunner on SoFi’s $697.6M personal loan securitization

source.label: SoFi の発表(2025年3月3日)
source.quote: Goldman Sachs was the structuring agent and joint lead bookrunner with Bank of America.

relations.text: SoFiの6.976億ドルの個人ローン証券化で、共同主幹事を務めた
relations.text_en: Bank of America was joint lead bookrunner on SoFi’s $697.6M personal loan securitization

source.label: SoFi の発表(2025年3月3日)
source.quote: Goldman Sachs was the structuring agent and joint lead bookrunner with Bank of America.

relations.text: SoFi傘下のGalileoが、Daveの口座・カードの取引処理を担う複数年契約
relations.text_en: Multi-year agreement under which SoFi’s Galileo processes transactions for Dave’s accounts and cards

source.label: Dave 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Under this agreement, Galileo processes all transactions for ExtraCash, Dave Checking accounts, and Dave Debit Cards, and handles corresponding payments, adjustments, and settlement.

relations.text: Chimeが10-Kで、競合するネット専業の金融機関としてSoFiを挙げる
relations.text_en: Chime names SoFi among online-only financial institutions it competes with

source.label: Chime 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete with online-only financial institutions, such as Ally, Discover, and SoFi

relations.text: Marqetaが10-Kで、API型の競合としてSoFi傘下のGalileoを挙げる
relations.text_en: Marqeta names SoFi’s Galileo among modern API-based competitors

source.label: Marqeta 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: modern API-based providers, such as Galileo, i2c, and Visa DPS

relations.text: Q2が10-Kで、組み込み金融の主な競合としてSoFi傘下のGalileoを挙げる
relations.text_en: Q2 names SoFi’s Galileo as a primary competitor in embedded finance

source.label: Q2 Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: With respect to our Helix solution, we primarily compete with Galileo Financial Technologies, Marqeta and Green Dot in the BaaS and embedded finance markets

relations.text: Evertecが10-Kで、カード処理の競合としてSoFi傘下のGalileoを挙げる
relations.text_en: Evertec names SoFi’s Galileo among its card-processing competitors

source.label: Evertec 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In payment services, we compete with several other third-party card processors, debit networks, and financial technology providers, including Tecnocom Telecomunicaciones y Energía, S.A., Galileo Financial Technologies, LLC, Marqeta, Inc.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
